about_the_game:
In Cart Capers, your shopping cart is your ticket to glory! Race through chaotic, trap-filled obstacle courses where skill, timing, and a little bit of sabotage can mean the difference between victory and wipeout. Compete against your friends or other players online as you pull off wheelies, launch daring jumps, and drift your way to the finish line. Whether you're speeding through tight racetracks or dodging deadly traps in deathrun gauntlets, one thing is certain — only the craftiest cart-rider will cross the finish line first!

Features

Precision Controls Master unique cart physics: push off the ground to move, pop wheelies to navigate tricky obstacles, and combine them with drifts and jumps to outmaneuver the competition.

Competitive Multiplayer Races Challenge up to 8 players online! Shove your friends into traps, steal victory at the last second, or work together to survive — it’s up to you.

Two Distinct Challenge Paths

  • Race Tracks: Focus on pure speed, smart steering, and risky shortcuts.

  • Deathruns: Face brutal trap-filled obstacle courses where timing and survival skills are key.

Straightforward to Wild Start with beginner-friendly tracks designed to teach the basics — then take on progressively harder levels that test every trick in your cart-riding arsenal.

Cartoon-Style Visuals Bright, energetic environments and playful designs that keep the action lively and fun from start to finish.

Sabotage or Team Up Push opponents into hazards or team up to overcome impossible traps. Friendships will be tested. Rivalries will be born.

Ready to Roll?

Jump into Cart Capers — where every corner could mean a jump, a crash, or a moment of absolute triumph.
